name: Get eCommerce onboarding status
description: Call this when you need to retrieve the current onboarding status for the eCommerce integration, including whether a store is connected and if the account is eligible for onboarding. Use the "ecommerce.start_onboarding" action instead if you need to initiate the onboarding process.

store_connected.description: Indicates whether a store is currently connected.

onboarding_eligible.description: Indicates whether the account is eligible to start onboarding.

onboarding_ineligibility_reason.description: Reason why onboarding is not eligible, if applicable.

onboarding.description: Details of the onboarding process if it has been started; null otherwise.
